title: A Novel Bacteriocin Against Shigella flexneri From Lactiplantibacillus plantarum Isolated From Tilapia Intestine: Purification, Antibacterial Properties and Antibiofilm Activity.
A Novel Bacteriocin Against Shigella flexneri From Lactiplantibacillus plantarum Isolated From Tilapia Intestine: Purification, Antibacterial Properties and Antibiofilm Activity.

comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (46.15%) to PG-L Mol. Wt: 1049.197; GRAVY: 0.609; Mol Formula: C46H76N14O14; mol ex coeff: 0. Discovery:screened LAB strains isolated from the tilapia intestine. Activity: inhibited S. flexneri strain 14 (MIC 12.65 ug/ml) S. flexneri_14 growth. It also has antibiofilm activity. It also inhibits the growth of S. aureus 26 and E. coli 02. Antimicrobial robustness: activity is susceptible to proteases; gradually decreased with increase in pH (73.74% at pH 12); retained 56.06% antibacterial activity at 121oC. The effect is killing. MOA: treatment with the peptide caused the release of K+, ATP, and LDH, membrane active. It binds genomic DNA as well ( Xin et al., 2023). e2/2023.
